page: Amazon Web Services m8id.16xlarge is a general-purpose server powered by the Nitro hypervisor and an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor. It features 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores running at 3.9 GHz, supported by a 480 MB L3 cache. The system is equipped with 256 GB of DDR5 memory operating at 7 GHz, providing a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Local storage is provided via 3800 GB of NVMe SSD instance store volumes, and baseline network bandwidth is rated at 30 Gbps.

In benchmark evaluations, the server demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, placing in the top 25% for stress-ng and PassMark tests. Its memory subsystem achieves top-tier read-only bandwidth for small cached blocks and strong performance for large uncached blocks. The processor's support for Advanced Vector Extensions and Advanced Matrix Extensions contributes to top-tier results in image processing, text processing, and software compilation.

The server is highly efficient for data-intensive workloads due to its bundled high-speed local NVMe storage and DDR5 memory architecture. However, a performance tradeoff is visible in large-scale machine learning tasks; while prompt processing for a 70B LLM model reaches top-tier speeds, text generation for the same model drops to average levels. This profile makes the instance highly effective for static web serving, database operations, software development pipelines, and medium-scale language model inference.
